{"reason": "All 34 bad rows and all 4 stockouts come from the suggest-alternative-supplier branch (e.g. medium/5.3d and medium/2.8d cost 195000 each). Alert-planner costs 35000 (<45000) and always arrives in time, so switching that branch's action cuts cost and stockouts while leaving low-risk monitor untouched.", "source": "(define (expedite-response risk-level inventory-days)
  (cond
    ((and (>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'high)) (< inventory-days 5))
     (list 'alert-planner 'immediate-expedite-review))
    ((>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'medium))
     (list 'alert-planner 'immediate-expedite-review))
    (else (list 'monitor))))"}
